before-horror-from-the-deep.npc: Oh, thank Armadyl! I am in such a worry... please help me!

steps.npc: Oh... it is terrible... horrible... My boyfriend lives here in this lighthouse, but I haven't seen him the last few days! I think something terrible has happened!
Look, you can see for yourself that the light has gone out, and the front door is locked up tight! He would NEVER do that!
With the light off this coastline is terribly dangerous to ships! And to lock the front door so that nobody can turn the light back on?

steps.player: Maybe he just went on holiday or something? Must be pretty boring living in a lighthouse.

steps.npc: That is terribly irresponsible! He is far too thoughtful for that! He would never leave it unattended! He would also never leave without telling me!
Please, I know something terrible has happened to him... I can sense it! Please... please help me adventurer!
Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
has trapped me on this causeway! You seem to have got here okay somehow, so if you could go and visit my cousin and get the spare key I left him,
as well as fix the bridge enough so that I can go and speak to my family in Rellekka and tell them whats happened, I will be eternally grateful!

steps.prompt: Start the Horror from the Deep quest?

steps.npc: OH! THANK YOU SO MUCH! I know my darling would never have left with the lighthouse lights off and without even telling me where he's gone!
My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.
I don't exactly know where he has gone, but I am sure he went somewhere to practise his agility. If you see him, his name is Gunnjorn. Mention my name, he will recognise it.

options.text: How can I fix the bridge?

steps.player: How can I fix the bridge?

steps.npc: Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.
Just use a plank on each side of the bridge. You will need a hammer, and thirty steel nails for each plank you use as well. I believe there are some planks near here...

options.text: I'll see what I can do

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

after-horror-from-the-deep.npc: Oh! Thank you so much for all of your help in rescuing my darling Jossik!
I do not know what would have happened to him had you not chanced along this path!

after-horror-from-the-deep.player: Don't worry about it, I was glad to help out.

book-about-lighthouses.player: Hey, I have something you might be interested in...

book-about-lighthouses.text: You show the book to Larrissa.

book-about-lighthouses.npc: A book about lighthouses? I love it! I actually have something you might be interested in as well...

book-about-lighthouses.text: Larrissa swaps the book about lighthouses for a bucket of paint.

book-about-lighthouses.npc: I have way too much of that paint for the lighthouse. If you want more of it, just ask!

options.text: Hello again. How are you doing?
Do you have any more paint?

steps.player: Do you have any more paint?

steps.npc: Certainly. How much do you want?

steps.text: Larrissa hands you over some paint.

MWDQ_R.npc: Oh... my poor darling Jossik... I just know something terrible has happened...
